_comment: The classes this site teaches. Every page shows one class at a time; the picker in the header switches between them and remembers the choice. 'paths' are repository folders that belong to a class (the first class with an empty path list owns everything not claimed by another class). 'private_paths' are folders that belong to a class but are never published: the build leaves their files out of the manifests and tools/assemble_site.py removes them from _site, so answer keys never reach the website. 'phases' are the halves of a course: a notebook/problem is put in a phase when its group is listed in phase.groups, and the practice page can group by phase. 'solutions' decides whether the exercise page may show a reference solution: 'shown' (default) or 'hidden' (hints only). Re-run tools/build_index.py after editing.

courses.title: Python for accounting
courses.summary: The class exercise notebooks, from first scripts to pandas and regression. Solutions and reference answers are shown, because this class works through them together.

phases.title: Part 1 — Intro to Python
phases.summary: Values, strings, lists, loops, dictionaries, functions and errors.

phases.title: Part 2 — Data analysis
phases.summary: pandas: loading, cleaning, sorting, merging, plotting and regression.

courses.title: Python for finance
courses.summary: Two halves: guided modules and Python functions in plain .py files first, then notebooks with DataFrames and regression. Work through Practice 1 to 19 in order. Solutions are never shown — hints are, and every exercise runs on its own data.

phases.title: First half — Python foundations
phases.summary: Guided modules first, then loops, functions and the statistics library in plain .py files. Practice 1 to 9. No notebooks and no DataFrames yet.

phases.title: Second half — Notebooks, DataFrames and regression
phases.summary: Work in .ipynb files: load data, clean it, group and merge it, form portfolios, plot them and finish with a regression. Practice 10 to 19.

phases.title: Lecture notebooks — one per class meeting
phases.summary: The class-by-class notebooks: loading data, loops and functions, the statistics library, the CDF, empirical probability, pandas basics, filtering, data review and groupby.
